Goldberg keeps your journal on this device. Smart Practice analyzes ambient microphone sound locally, including while locked or in another app, only after you explicitly start it. No raw audio is stored, uploaded or transcribed. Pause or Stop releases capture. Backups and CSV are unencrypted; your document provider may synchronize them. Catalogue queries go to Open Opus and Wikimedia services. Practice notes and microphone audio are never sent there. Reminders are local and optional. Keep independent backups before updates or restoration. Optional Google sign-in contacts Google for account identity only; imported profile pictures obey your media download preference. Practice history is never synchronized to Google. Daily quotations may request their public-domain source from Project Gutenberg once per day; offline fallback is bundled.

Learn betimes the fundamental principles of Harmony.
You may play too slow or too fast; both are faults.
Endeavour to play easy pieces well and with elegance; that is better than to play difficult pieces badly.
Frequently sing in choruses, especially the middle parts, this will help to make you a real musician.
Do not neglect to attend good Operas.
Highly esteem the Old, but take also a warm interest in the New.
Look deeply into life, and study it as diligently as the other arts and sciences.
By means of industry and perseverance you will rise higher and higher.
Without enthusiasm nothing great can be effected in art.
